title: Schedule of Cancellation, Notice and Move Terms - Beacon Ridge Solar Share Plans
content:
Cancellation and move terms of Community Solar Subscriptions, by plan.

| Plan | Free look after allocation date | Notice before cancellation takes effect | Cancellation effective date | Cancellation fee | Fee waived on a move out of the utility's territory | Moves with the subscriber to a new premise of the same utility | Assignable to the next occupant of the premise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | notice date plus notice days | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | notice date plus notice days | $100.00 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | notice date plus notice days | $150.00 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | notice date plus notice days | $200.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | notice date plus notice days | $250.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | notice date plus notice days | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | No |

**Footnotes**

(a) *Free look.* The free look is the number of calendar days after the allocation date during which the subscriber may cancel without any fee: 30 calendar days on every plan.

(b) *Notice.* The notice period is the number of calendar days of notice before a cancellation takes effect: 30 calendar days on Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex and Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible, and 90 calendar days on the 1-Year, 5-Year, 10-Year and 20-Year plans.

(c) *Effective date.* The cancellation date is fixed as the notice date plus the plan's notice days.

(d) *Fee.* The cancellation fee is the fee for cancelling before the term end date outside the free look, stated in dollars and cents.

(e) *Move out of the utility.* On every plan the cancellation fee is waived when the subscriber moves out of the utility's territory.

(f) *Move within the utility.* On every plan the subscription moves with the subscriber to a new premise of the same utility.

(g) *Assignment.* Only Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year and Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year may be assigned to the next occupant of the premise.

**Hypothetical effective dates**

|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 30 calendar days | 10 July |
| 10 June | 90 calendar days | 8 September |
